findings.evidence: template/scripts/finish_task.py:124-140: sync_queue_merged_task returns False when queue_enabled(work) is false, or when queue_local_status returns None, which happens for an unadmitted PR with no admit event. A merged PR with no queue admission, or with the queue disabled, still falls through to managed_candidate and the developer handoff. The spec scenario is stated for any exact merged PR.
findings.summary: The spec says that when the exact PR of the task branch is merged, finish reconciles before any handoff. The implementation only detects a merge through the publication queue, so the spec's wording is broader than the code.

findings.evidence: template/scripts/finish_task.py:124-140 duplicates the logic at 1060-1082. The test side_effect had to be changed to [None, None, waiting]. The design acknowledges only 'one extra PR read'; the merged case also repeats the sync.
findings.summary: For a coordinator-mode task whose queue PR is merged, finish runs queue_local_status and sync_merged_task twice. The first pass is the new early check. The second is the existing block after the provenance checks (lines 1058-1082). The two passes duplicate the GitHub reads and the sync logic.
